text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said analyst Joseph Arsenio cut his rating on shares of Executone Information Systems Inc to hold from buy after Executone reported a Q1 earnings shortfall.

-- Arsenio cut his 1997 estimate to $0.14/shr on sales of $207.7 million from $0.24/shr on sales of $212.8 million. He cut his 1998 estimate to $0.24/shr on sales of $212.8 million from $0.34/shr and $238.1 million. He cut the rating and estimates "to reflect the current adverse sales trends."
-- Executone said it earned $0.01 a share on sales of $39 million in the first quarter versus Hambrecht's estimate of $0.04 a share on sales of $45.5 million.
